title: SOLID design
rule: Use SOLID principles in production code design.
why: Keeps responsibilities focused and dependencies understandable, so changes remain localized as the codebase evolves.

title: Clean Code
rule: Apply Clean Code principles in production and test code.
why: Keeps code readable and intention-revealing, preventing avoidable maintenance mistakes.

title: Unit-test coverage floor
rule: Maintain unit-test code coverage of at least 65%.
why: Prevents the core behaviour from becoming unverified as the server evolves.

name: Resolved store snapshot
problem: Append-only FluencyLoop records need one deterministic current view without hiding malformed or unfamiliar local evidence.
how: The reader discovers sorted JSONL files, reads each line independently, replaces supported identities with their newest record, and returns unkeyed records and diagnostics alongside the resolved state.

append-only log

title: Resilient local inspection
rule: Preserve valid local evidence and report damaged input as diagnostics; do not fail the whole inspection because one local record is malformed.
why: Prevents one damaged JSONL line from hiding the remaining repository evidence.
